description: The image displays two pie charts, titled "All Changes" and "All Errors," which are used to illustrate the distribution of different types of spelling corrections and errors in a Chinese spelling correction system. The chart on the left, "All Changes," is divided into five segments: a large light green segment representing 50%, a medium-sized pale yellow segment at 26%, a small dark green segment at 4%, a medium-sized golden yellow segment at 14%, and a small blue segment at 5%. The chart on the right, "All Errors," also has five segments: a large light green segment at 56%, a medium-sized pale yellow segment at 29%, a small dark green segment at 3%, a medium-sized golden yellow segment at 6%, and a small blue segment at 1%. A legend on the right side of the image correlates the colors with specific categories: light green for PW, dark green for PW, pale yellow for R, golden yellow for RW, and blue for NW. Both charts visually represent the proportion of different correction types or error types, with the largest segment in each chart being the light green "PW" category. The percentages are explicitly labeled within each slice of the pie charts.
